matches.text: The parties expect to make available to one another certain non-public, confidential and/or proprietary information, both oral and written, which may include information concerning their respective business prospects and plans, financial condition, technology, customers, know-how, trade secrets, operations, assets and liabilities (collectively, the “Evaluation Material”).

(ii) is or becomes available to the receiving party from a source other than the disclosing party or any of its Representatives, provided that such source was not known or reasonably should be known by the receiving party to be bound by a duty of confidentiality with respect to such information;
(iii) is disclosed by the disclosing party to a third party without a duty of confidentiality;

Promptly upon notice from either party that it does not wish to proceed with the Transaction, each party shall return to the other party or destroy all copies of the Evaluation Material (including all documents based thereon) in its possession or in the possession of its Representatives, except that outside counsel to the receiving party may retain one copy of the Evaluation Material for archival purposes and solely to comply with applicable law, rule or regulation.
The Evaluation Materials may include human resources data and/or other information that serves to identify one or more individuals (“PII”).

Choose Entailment if the contract supports the exact hypothesis (including exceptions), Contradiction if it states the opposite, or NotMentioned if it does not decide it.
A search miss is NOT evidence of absence. Seek paraphrases, exceptions and nearby clauses. Cite all relevant observed span IDs. Never cite an unobserved span.
Each response MUST be ONE JSON object: {"tool":"tool_name","arguments":{...}}. No prose or markdown outside the JSON.
Use the available tools. At most six search/read actions; then submit_result. Keep explanations short (<=80 words).
For NotMentioned, evidence_ids must be []. For the other labels provide nonempty evidence_ids.
Tool definitions: [{"name": "search_contract", "arguments": {"query": "string", "k": "integer 1..6, default 5"}, "description": "BM25 search inside this contract only; returns numbered original evidence spans."}, {"name": "read_spans", "arguments": {"span_ids": "array of 1..8 integer IDs"}, "description": "Read full numbered spans. IDs are zero-based, immutable within this contract."}, {"name": "submit_result", "arguments": {"label": ["Entailment", "Contradiction", "NotMentioned"], "evidence_ids": "array of observed integer IDs", "explanation": "short string"}, "description": "Submit conclusion. NotMentioned requires no evidence IDs; a failed search alone is not proof of absence."}]

arguments.label: Contradiction
arguments.explanation: The contract states that Confidential Information is treated as confidential when received by parties, directors, officers, employees, agents, or advisors. It does not permit sharing with third parties; instead, it imposes confidentiality obligations on recipients. Thus, sharing with third parties is not allowed, contradicting the hypothesis.

matches.text: The parties expect to make available to one another certain non-public, confidential and/or proprietary information, both oral and written, which may include information concerning their respective business prospects and plans, financial condition, technology, customers, know-how, trade secrets, operations, assets and liabilities (collectively, the “Evaluation Material”).

(ii) is or becomes available to the receiving party from a source other than the disclosing party or any of its Representatives, provided that such source was not known or reasonably should be known by the receiving party to be bound by a duty of confidentiality with respect to such information;

Promptly upon notice from either party that it does not wish to proceed with the Transaction, each party shall return to the other party or destroy all copies of the Evaluation Material (including all documents based thereon) in its possession or in the possession of its Representatives, except that outside counsel to the receiving party may retain one copy of the Evaluation Material for archival purposes and solely to comply with applicable law, rule or regulation.
The Evaluation Materials may include human resources data and/or other information that serves to identify one or more individuals (“PII”).
